description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of DeepfakeFace under the facebody category
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸人体（facebody）类目下的换脸鉴别DeepfakeFace的语法及示例
name: DeepfakeFace

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure (image Table). Up to 10 elements are supported, meaning you can detect up to 10 images simultaneously. We recommend using an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

For this API, the system automatically converts the OSS URL to an internal network address before downloading the file. Therefore, invoking this API does not incur OSS traffic billing
fields.help_zh:
待检测的图像URL地址。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个图片检测任务结构体（image表）。最多支持10个元素，即同时最多对10张图片进行检测。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

对于该接口，系统会自动将OSS链接地址转成内网地址然后再下载文件，所以调用该接口并不会产生OSS流量计费
fields.name: image_url

fields.help_en:
Base64-encoded string of the image. When both Base64 and URL are provided, the URL takes precedence.  
For instructions on Base64 encoding files, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.help_zh:
图像Base64编码字符串。当与URL方式共存时，URL方式优先。
文件的Base64编码处理操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468191.html
fields.name: image_data

Data.description_en: The content of the returned result data.

FaceNumber.description_en:
The number of faces detected in a single image.  
If no face is detected, FaceNumber returns 0
FaceNumber.description_zh:
单张图片检测到的人脸数量。
如果未检测到人脸，FaceNumber返回为0

ImageURL.description_en: The image URL address corresponding to the request
ImageURL.description_zh: 对应请求中的图像URL地址

Results.description_en: The return result. When the invocation succeeds, the result contains one or more elements.
Results.description_zh: 返回结果。调用成功时返回结果中包含一个或多个元素

Confidence.description_en: The value range is [0.00, 100.00]. A lower value indicates a higher probability that the face is genuine
Confidence.description_zh: 取值范围为[0.00,100.00]。数值越低表示属于真脸的概率越大

Label.description_en:
The categorization of the detection result. Valid values include:

normalface: genuine face image
deepfakeface: face-swapped image

If no face is detected, the Label returns `deepfake`
Label.description_zh:
检测结果的分类，取值包括：

normalface：真脸照片
deepfakeface：换脸照片

如果未检测到人脸，则Label返回为`deepfake`

MessageTips.description_en:
Prompt messages.  
If the input face is blurred, occluded, or at a large angle, the following message is returned: `blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.`  
If no face is detected, the following message is returned: `no face detected, try again please.`
MessageTips.description_zh:
提示信息。
如输入模糊、遮挡或大角度等的人脸，则返回提示信息：`blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.`  
如未检测到人脸，则返回提示信息：`no face detected, try again please.`
MessageTips.example: blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.

Height.description_en: The height of the detection bounding box

Left.description_en: The x coordinate of the top-left point of the detection box
Left.description_zh: 检测框左上角的点x坐标

Top.description_en: The y-coordinate of the top-left point of the detection bounding box
Top.description_zh: 检测框左上角的点y坐标

Width.description_en: The width of the detection bounding box

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the detection job.
